text:
Predicates:
Private(x) ::: x is a private university.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
Research(x) ::: x is a research university.
Moved(x, y) ::: x moved to location y.
ValuedAt(x, y) ::: x was valued at y.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x has been organized into y.
List(x, y) ::: List of x includes elements of y.
Premises:
Private(YaleUniversity) ∧ IvyLeague(YaleUniversity) ∧ Research(YaleUniversity) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
Moved(YaleUniversity, NewHaven) ∧ MovedInYear(YaleUniversity, year1716) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
ValuedAt(YaleUniversity, $42.3billion) ::: Yale university's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(YaleUniversity, {constituentCollegesAndSchools}) ∧ List(residentialCollegesAtYale, {BenjaminFranklinCollege, BerkeleyCollege, BranfordCollege, DavenportCollege, EzraStilesCollege, GraceHopperCollege, JonathanEdwardsCollege, MorseCollege, PauliMurrayCollege, PiersonCollege, SaybrookCollege, SillimanCollege, TimothyDwightCollege, TrumbullCollege, YaleGraduateSchoolOfArtsAndSciences, twelveProfessionalSchools}) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools: the residential colleges, the Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, and twelve professional schools.
Conclusion:
Uncertain ::: Yale University has the largest university endowment of any educational institution.
